title: listNotifications request
description: GET /v1/notifications - request. Paginated notification inbox of the caller's firm (polling fallback of the SSE stream).
$comment: Source: DISENO S7 (c) notifications AP-G2 (paginated inbox), (e) 'GET /v1/notifications?cursor', (h) polling fallback every T_poll; PRD RF-032, RF-120. Audience: PUBLIC (served to the UI). Residency: REGIONAL (cell of the firm, resolved by the stateless global edge firmId -> cell, RF-093); the firm comes from the authenticated context, never from the URL. Idempotency: safe read (GET). Pagination: cursor + limit <= N_pagemax (DISENO 3.8.5).

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120).

queryParams.description: Query parameters (exactly as documented; unknown parameters are rejected with 400).
